scope: Eight selected same-checkpoint fixed16 cases, normal/noC/direct-only/Q-off, frames0/20/40/60/80. Sentinel selection is not an all60 pass rate.

cases.VP002: Shared initial image shows two people holding long flexible material. Normal/Q-off lift a loop; noC/direct-only are more static and produce extra detached objects. The shared initial image does not depict a close-up thin wooden strip.
cases.VP004: The shared black-and-white man/child image is already inconsistent with the ruler request. All modes develop structural corruption; noC has large white torn regions and direct-only distorts the face. Input mismatch does not justify the generated corruption.
cases.VP009: Normal/Q-off preserve worker and tool better than direct-only, whose late white tool grows into a large frame. NoC bends over holding the device; none clearly lifts the panel.
cases.VP015: Normal preserves rowing scene and gives more visible dripping but changes oar/water details. Other modes retain scene with less clear dripping. Moderate physical contribution is consistent with PC5 versus4, not complete quality certification.
cases.VP016: All preserve insect/leaf/probe reasonably in the samples; detailed twitch/contact needs denser temporal inspection. No large geometry advantage from dropping a module.
cases.VP026: Shared first image is a sea rig inconsistent with two people stretching a cord. Normal largely preserves/static rig; noC/direct-only/Q-off create additional humans/ropes or tangle the rig. High PC here is not fulfillment of the requested process.
cases.VP034: All retain an already inflated floating balloon and mostly show vertical travel rather than clear inflation. Normal has one higher SA score, which is not proof of a correctly completed inflation process.
cases.VP038: All eventually deform or disconnect the paint roller/handle. NoC produces a torn roller early; normal/direct/Q-off preserve some detail longer but fail late geometry.

conclusions: I2V removal of associated reading does not reproduce the T2V benefit;009 shows additional severe tool corruption, while034 loses one Joint.
Physics has some process/preservation contribution, but many failures persist in both normal and noC; shared input mismatches are a separate issue.
